description:
The DVB-T2 LDPC table interpretation note states that the sub-diagonal of the parity part wraps, while the parity-check builder adds no wrap entry. A superseding record corrects the statement and the note keeps its bytes.

## Background

`crates/gf2-coding/src/ldpc/dvb_t2/table_interpretation.md` says under "Dual-Diagonal Parity Structure" that parity bit $p$ connects to check $(p-1) \bmod m$ and that parity bit 0 connects to check $m-1$; its diagram shows that entry. `crates/gf2-coding/src/ldpc/dvb_t2/builder.rs` adds the sub-diagonal edge only for $p > 0$, so row 0 has no sub-diagonal entry. The note is a digest-pinned input of committed benchmark surveys (the `producing-inputs*.json` lists under `dev/active/`), so a byte change invalidates their evidence. The owner ruled on 2026-10-04 that a separate record supersedes the false statement, as the P-02 amendment record does for the Zen 3 protocol.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: A record beside the note states the parity structure the builder implements, names the superseded statements of the note, and cites the builder item and a test that asserts the structure.
- [hard] REQ-02: `table_interpretation.md` is byte-identical to its state before the change.
- [hard] REQ-03: Every place in the repository that directs a reader to the note for the parity structure also leads to the record.
- [hard] REQ-04: The record cites the standard through its registry key and states only what the code at HEAD does.
title: Supersede the sub-diagonal wrap statement of the DVB-T2 table note
